format: Xfer LFO shapes (Serum 2 .XferShape, Serum 1 and LFOTool .shp, LFOTool .fxp presets)
about: Worked out 2026-11-13 from Solomon's Documents\Xfer folders; the reader is crates/mo-formats/src/serum.rs (its opening comment has the whole layout). Not loaded by Format Lab yet: these files aren't object trees, so they're kept here as notes. In every format a value is kept top down (0 at the top: value = 1 - y), a bend runs 0 to 1 with 0.5 straight and belongs to the line to the next point (below 0.5 it moves early, above late, whichever way the line goes), and a shape repeats, so its last point joins the first value at x = 1.

files.layout: 'XferJson' 0; u64 LE JSON length; JSON header (fileType 'XferShape', product 'Serum2'|'Serum2FX', productVersion, version); u32 LE unpacked body size; u32 LE 2; zstd frame. Body is CBOR: map with 'LFO' => { xVals, yVals, curveVals (lists of numPoints + 1; the last entry is always 1, 1, 0.5 and isn't part of the shape), numPoints, sometimes loopbackPointNum }, then a copy of the header's fields.
files.proof: Basic pairs: 'Saw Up.XferShape' and 'saw up.shp', 'SC1' in both, read the same

files.layout: 2056 bytes: 64 f64 LE bends, 64 f64 x in pixels (0-388), 64 f64 y in pixels (0-240, 0 top), 64 f64 unused; byte 2048 the point count (1-64); bytes 2049-2055 are leftovers that differ whatever the shape.

18876 bytes: fxp 'CcnK' / 'FPCh' / fxID 'XFRa', chunk size 18816 (BE) at 56. From 60: twelve graphs list by list (12 x 64 f64 bends, then 12 x 64 x, then 12 x 64 y, in .shp pixels); then 384 bytes of settings with the twelve point counts at file offset 18844. A graph nobody drew is two straight points, (0, top) and (194 px, middle or bottom).
